feeds.title: Australian Wine Review
feeds.description: Andrew Graham's Wine and beer ramblings since 2008. This site (Australian Wine and Drinks Review or ozwinereview for short) is dedicated to talking about wine, beer, and other good things. Largely focuses on Australian things, but with an on anything great from all points of the globe.

feeds.title: QWine Reviews
feeds.description: QWine is an independent wine review website showcasing some of the best Wine flavors and stories Australia has to offer. Enjoy a vivid collection of bottles - from Riesling to the Chardonnay, reviewed and analysed for wine lovers like you. Stay in the know on the newest bottles and news through updates.

feeds.title: Travelling Corkscrew
feeds.description: I'm Casey and I LOVE wine, love to blog and love to share my experiences with whoever is keen to listen.

feeds.title: Food Wine Travel
feeds.description: Seeking out the hottest destinations & the best travel tips, the best places to eat, what wine you should be drinking & how to eat beautifully at home.

feeds.title: The Vinsomniac - Stuart Robinson
feeds.description: An Australian Wine Blog by Vinsomniac ~ noun: a person who suffers from vinsomnia, the inability, to obtain sufficient sleep, through constantly thinking about wine and related matters.

feeds.title: Winemusing
feeds.description: Lisa Johnston is a Sydney/London based wine educator, writer and wine business consultant who believes that wine should be fun, sometimes contemplative and never intimidating. A firm believer that the wine experience is one that should be shared, winemusing.com will celebrate the best wines, winemakers and wine experiences from Australia to London and beyond.

feeds.title: Grape Observer
feeds.description: Grape Observer is a wine blog authored by Sean Mitchell Dip WSET and established in 2009. It is an independent journal written for the love of wine.

feeds.title: Thomas Girgensohn's Australian Wine Reviews - and Beyond
feeds.description: I am a very interested amateur wine taster and drinker. I have collected wine since 1983 and hold a 1500 bottle wine collection of mainly red Australian wine, but also some wine from France, Italy and other countries. A blog of new and mature wine reviews for the discerning wine consumer.

feeds.title: The Cheeky Vino
feeds.description: Wine shouldn't be hard or difficult to understand, it should be enjoyable! Join me as I explore wine without the stuffiness - just the good stuff!

feeds.title: Vinodiversity
feeds.description: Vinodiversity is a project of Darby Higgs, a Melbourne based wine writer and enthusiast. This website and the associated publications deal primarily with Australian wine made using 'alternative' grape varieties.

feeds.title: The Intrepid Wino
feeds.description: The Intrepid Wino is me, James Scarcebrook, hailing from Melbourne, Australia. I've worked in the wine industry since 2004. I named the blog (and subsequently myself) The Intrepid Wino when I was about to embark on a wine odyssey that would take me around the wine world over a sixteen month period. As a wine professional I am what some people (mostly my friends and family) call a Wino. The Intrepid nature of my journey and my own passion to discover all there is about wine.

feeds.title: My Wine Affair
feeds.description: Wine blog, giving monthly insights into the world of wine, giving you useful information, tips and news. BLOG ARCHIVES Wine notes from South Africa.

feeds.title: Just Wines Blog » Wines
feeds.description: A blog about Australian wines, wineries and events, wine facts, special occasion wines, and wine gifting. Just Wines is an online wine shop in Australia.

feeds.title: Australian Wine Tour Co. Blog
feeds.description: Offering a fun, educating and entertaining wine tour to the luscious Yarra Valley! Established in 1998 by Matthew Noble, Australian Wine Tour Company are the market leaders in winery tourism offering both public and private touring options.
